comments.author: Simmi
comments.text:
Hi Mr.Simon

Yesterday was my 5th attempt at IELTS, this time God held my hand and we together crossed the ocean. I needed 7.0 band in each but every time, my writing used to be 6.5. I took three consecutive attempts in May and then stopped. I just decided to relax. Then in last week of August, decided to take a date, booked 6th September.once in a while, i was a silent but occasional user of Mr. Simon's website, never asked any question, never posted any comment .Three days before my exam, as usual visited the same site.there was a question posted by Simon sir: find the mistake in the draft of the essay. This question tproved to be turning point, I didn't know that mistake and finally sir explained that if your opinion is asked, don't write some people believe ............ My exam was so near and I got confused. So just went on opening link after link and finally reached at a conclusion that it is better to use "while" in the sentence and say "while I agree with A, I favour B. By writing this sentence in my introduction, it became so easy to write a flowing essay. That day in exam., I understood what Simon sir meant by a flowing essay. I am sharing my views,so that it could be of some help to many people like me. May God bless you all. I don't know whether I am right or wrong, but now I feel it is easier to write a balanced essay ( than a strong opinion essay) because you can easily write about both sides.

Finally, let me tell my scores to respected Simon Sir.......

W-8.0, R-8.5, L-8.0, S-7.5, Overall-8.0

I am falling short of words to convey my thanks to Simon sir. Just accept my warm regards and keep it up.
